howChosen: Quiet, slow, contemplative pieces that would not fight a dusk walk. All from incompetech.com, whose whole catalogue Kevin MacLeod releases under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 (checked against incompetech.com/music/royalty-free/faq.html on the day of the fetch).

tracks.title: Winter Chimes
tracks.author: Kevin MacLeod
tracks.why: Struck metal and long decays — the nearest thing on offer to the trail's own music box.
tracks.attribution: Winter Chimes by Kevin MacLeod. Source: https://incompetech.com/. Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

tracks.title: Peaceful Desolation
tracks.author: Kevin MacLeod
tracks.why: Wide, slow and almost empty — closest in temper to the long quiet stretches between moments.
tracks.attribution: Peaceful Desolation by Kevin MacLeod. Source: https://incompetech.com/. Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

tracks.title: Water Lily
tracks.author: Kevin MacLeod
tracks.why: Gentle, unhurried, pentatonic-leaning — it would sit in the same key family as the ensemble.
tracks.attribution: Water Lily by Kevin MacLeod. Source: https://incompetech.com/. Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

tracks.title: Heartbreaking
tracks.author: Kevin MacLeod
tracks.why: Solo piano, plain and slow — a test of whether the trail wants a tune at all, or only weather.
tracks.attribution: Heartbreaking by Kevin MacLeod. Source: https://incompetech.com/. Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

tracks.title: Ossuary 1 - A Beginning
tracks.author: Kevin MacLeod
tracks.why: A walking pulse under a held drone — the one candidate with a step in it.
tracks.attribution: Ossuary 1 - A Beginning by Kevin MacLeod. Source: https://incompetech.com/. Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

tracks.title: Meditation Impromptu 01
tracks.author: Kevin MacLeod
tracks.why: Plucked strings with plenty of air between phrases — the silence doctrine, in someone else's hands.
tracks.attribution: Meditation Impromptu 01 by Kevin MacLeod. Source: https://incompetech.com/. Licensed under Creative Commons: By Attribution 4.0 License — https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
